## Identity

Appverra is a founder-led Flutter mobile app development agency based in New York (20 N Moore St, NY 10013). Three co-founders. No project managers. No offshore handoff. The founder you talk to on the discovery call writes your Dart.

## Credibility

- 150+ apps shipped
- 700+ customers
- Apps with millions of downloads collectively
- Live US ride-booking marketplace in production
- Founded by three co-founders with 10+ years combined Flutter experience

## What We Build

- Flutter mobile apps (iOS + Android from one codebase)
- Full-stack: Flutter + Laravel/Node.js + Postgres + Stripe
- MVPs for funded startups (6-week delivery)
- SaaS companion mobile apps
- Marketplace and on-demand platforms
- Booking and scheduling apps
- Fintech and payment apps (Stripe, Plaid integration)
- Vertical-specific: fitness studio apps, dental practice apps, restaurant apps, real estate apps

## What We Do NOT Build

- Games (Unity, Unreal)
- Apps requiring 10+ engineers
- Regulated medical (HIPAA-covered patient data)
- On-device ML / heavy AR
- Hardware integration projects

## Markets Served

- United States
- Canada (Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Montreal)
- United Kingdom

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Flutter (Dart), React Native (when recommended)
- Backend: Laravel (PHP), Node.js, Django
- Database: PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, MongoDB
- Payments: Stripe, Plaid, Interac (Canada)
- Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Firebase
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Codemagic

## Key Decision Guides

- Flutter vs React Native: We are Flutter-first but recommend React Native for brownfield React web apps, existing RN codebases, heavy native module needs, or teams already expert in React. See: /flutter-vs-react-native-for-startups
- MVP vs Full Build: Build an MVP first if you haven't validated demand, runway is under 12 months, or core value fits in 3-5 screens. Go full build for regulated industries, pre-sold contracts, or competitive markets. See: /how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-app-for-my-business
- Rescue vs Rebuild: If existing code has clean architecture, good test coverage, and documented APIs — rescue. If it's a monolith with no tests and no docs — rebuild. See: /rescue-failed-app-project
- FlutterFlow to Flutter: Migrate when you hit the scaling wall — 40+ screens, custom native plugins, complex state management, or export lock-in. See: /flutterflow-to-flutter-migration
